findings.title: Estimates go out and nothing follows them
findings.detail: Your site takes estimate requests through a form, and the confirmation is the last thing a customer hears.

findings.title: Nobody answers after 5pm
findings.detail: Collision calls come in right after the accident, which is mostly evenings and weekends.

findings.title: Your website does not load at all
findings.detail: The domain on your listings does not resolve. Anyone who taps through from a search result gets a browser error, and most of them do not try again.

findings.title: Cancellations leave holes nobody fills
findings.detail: A same-day cancellation is an hour of an empty table. There is no waitlist offer going out when a slot opens.
